title: feat(app-shell): Markdown editor with live preview for `doc` items in Studio (objectui#10188)
body:
Part of #10188 — the editor half. The menu half (body scope item 2, the addendum) and the acceptance checklist item stay with the card.

Clause-②: no

## What this does

Studio's metadata admin can now author a `doc` (ADR-0046) the way the maintainer asked for: an admin writes Markdown in the UI, sees it rendered live, and places it in a book. It is built INTO the existing edit flow, not beside it: `MetadataResourceEditPage` loads and saves the doc through the standard metadata write door (`PUT /meta/doc/:name`, `mode=draft`, then Publish), and a new `doc` Preview (`previews/DocPreview.tsx`) is the type's canvas, the way the object designer is the canvas for `fields`.

- **Source pane + live preview.** The preview renders through `SchemaRenderer` as `{ type: 'markdown' }`, the registry entry `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` provides and the docs portal (`DocPage`) renders with. `@object-ui/app-shell` takes no new dependency.
- **Only keys `DocSchema` declares.** The installed spec (17.5.0) has no `title` and no `locale` key on a doc: the title is `label` (`title` is a refused alias of it) and a locale variant is an entry of `translations` (`{ label?, description?, content }`). The locale switcher edits `translations[tag]`; a new variant is seeded from the default body, because an empty variant is served to that locale's readers as an empty page.
- **Book placement is a doc-side write.** A book stores no members (ADR-0046 §6.2.1): a doc joins a book group through its own `group` key, or a group's name/tag rule claims it. The picker lists every listed book's groups and writes `doc.group`; the readout under it ("Appears in: BOOK › GROUP") is computed with the spec's own `resolveBookTree` over this one doc, so it also reports a placement a rule makes with no explicit `group`, lists every book a shared group key lands in, and marks a public book.
- The canvas owns `content`, `translations` and `group` (`CANVAS_OWNED_KEYS`), so the properties form shows the header keys only; `doc` joins `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES`, so the editor is up during create too. The create form asks for `label` / `name` / `description`, suggests `name` from the title, and seeds `content: ''` (the one other key the spec requires).
- New strings live in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, the `engine.*` carve-out), plus a `doc` type label ("Documentation" / "文档"). No locale pack under `packages/i18n` changes.

## Premise readings (dispatch zone 2)

1. **What an admin sees for `doc` today** — measured on the published 17.5.0 console (`/_console`) against a 17.5.0 backend: the Documentation tile exists (the probe package ships a doc) and create is the generic SchemaForm (`Name*`, `Content*`, `Label`, `Description`) with `Content` a one-line text input (zero textareas) and no preview; the edit form of a packaged doc shows every key incl. the `_lock*` envelope and `Translations` as a JSON fallback. Holds as the PM guessed.
2. **Server contract** — `GET /meta/types` serves the doc row with `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, `allowOrgOverride: false` and `DocSchema`'s JSON Schema (`name`, `label`, `description`, `content`, `order`, `group`, `tags`, `translations` + the envelope; required `name`, `content`). `PUT /meta/doc/:name?mode=draft` answered 200 (`state=draft`), publish 200, and `GET /meta/doc/:name` served the doc afterwards. **Falsified in part:** the card's key list names `title` and `locale`, which the spec does not declare (see above); the editor writes `label` and `translations`.
3. **Preview through the registry** — holds. The console registers `markdown` lazily (`register-plugins.ts`); the live run below rendered a heading, a list and a link through it.
4. **Book overlay** — the premise's framing is **falsified**: assigning a doc to a book needs no book write at all. In the spec's model membership is derived, and the doc's own `group` key is the explicit placement; the server's tree endpoint honours it (measured: a doc saved with `group: reference` is listed under that group by `GET /meta/book/docprobe_manual/tree`). No book-write path was added. (For the record: `book` is `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, `allowOrgOverride: false` on 17.5.0, so runtime books are creatable and packaged ones are read-only.)
5. **Portal renders the saved doc** — holds for the page (see the live reading); the portal's book **sidebar** does not list it — see Acceptance notes.

## Live reading (reach)

A published `@objectstack/cli@17.5.0` backend (`os dev --fresh --seed-admin`, a probe package with book `docprobe_manual` = groups `getting_started` (rule `docprobe_gs_*`) and `reference`), this branch's console on vite, driven with Playwright:

- create at `/apps/setup/metadata/doc/new`: title "Live Guide" suggested `name = live_guide`; the picker offered "Not placed in a section, Getting started, Reference"; choosing Reference read back "Appears in: Probe Manual › Reference"; the live preview drew `h1` "Live Guide", `li` "first item" / "second item" and `a[href="https://example.com/docs"]` "the portal".
- Save navigated to `/apps/setup/metadata/doc/live_guide` with the same body and section; Publish cleared the pending draft; a full page reload showed the same body and section again.
- `/docs/docprobe_manual/live_guide` rendered the same heading, list and link.
- The server's refusal envelope was measured too: a doc carrying `title` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with `issues[0].message` "Unrecognized key(s) on this doc: `title`. Did you mean `title` → `label`? …"; the page test replays that envelope verbatim.

## Tests

All at HEAD `49a07a8a96` (this branch after merging `origin/main` `dded788ada`), run from the worktree root through the shared verify lock, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` — exit 0 (re-run after the merge).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project compiles both new suites).
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 --shard=K/6 packages/app-shell/`, K = 1 to 6 — all six exit 0: 932 test files (931 passed, 1 skipped), which is every tracked app-shell test file; 9301 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- New suites: `previews/DocPreview.test.tsx` (13 tests: source to `content` and the live preview, read-only mode, locale variants as `translations` entries and the refused tags, book placement written as `doc.group` with the resolver's readout incl. a rule placement, a shared key and a public book, an unknown key kept visible, a failed book list reported, a full-parse `DocSchema.safeParse` of a draft edited through every control, and no untranslated key in zh-CN) and `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx` (3 tests: create sends one spec-clean `PUT` through the standard door; reload shows the same body and section; the server's refusal message reaches the author).
- Found on the way: the full metadata-admin run reddened `ConditionWidget.conditionScope.test.tsx` ("every registered metadata resource has a ruled row") once `doc` became a registered resource; with the `doc: 'none'` row it is green.
- Gate scripts, all exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`. No locale pack under `packages/i18n` changed, so the pack-parity suites are not owed.
- ESLint (the package script is `eslint .`), narrowed to the 9 changed source files with `--format json`: 0 errors; `ResourceEditPage.tsx` reports 53 warnings, the same 53 its base version reports (linted from `git show` through `--stdin`), and every other changed file 0. The narrowing excludes nothing: the config sets no type-aware parser options and its local rules read no files, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED locally, because each needs a full console or all-package build that CI runs: `check:eager-closure`, `check:sdui-registration-pins` (exit 2, "No console build to weigh"), `check:published-dist`, and `check:readme-exports` as a whole (it cannot judge other unbuilt packages; with app-shell built, no app-shell README line was left unjudged). The editor's one value import from `@objectstack/spec/system` names a module the package entry already reaches through a static chain (`register-builtins` → `DashboardDefaultInspector` → `dashboard-schema` → `metadata-form-i18n`, which imports it); the eager-closure figure itself is CI's to read.

## Acceptance notes

- **Portal sidebar vs the tree endpoint (reported to the seat, not fixed here — `apps/console` is outside this card).** After the live run, `GET /meta/book/docprobe_manual/tree` lists `live_guide` under Reference, but the portal page `/docs/docprobe_manual/live_guide` renders a sidebar with Reference empty — on this branch's console and on the published 17.5.0 console alike. The console resolves the tree client-side and `scopeDocsToBook` (`apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts`) first drops docs outside the book's package, while the spec's `resolveBookTree` places a doc by its explicit `group` with no package scope. So a doc placed from this editor opens fine but is missing from the book's navigation.
- The directory tile for Documentation appears only once the active package holds a doc (the directory lists the types the active package contributes); the `/metadata/doc` list and its New button do not depend on it.
- Authoring into a code (read-only) package is refused by the server with `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (measured with `?package=com.example.docprobe`); the live run authored env-wide, which the server accepted.
- No client-side Zod validator is wired for `doc` (`clientValidation.ts` has no `doc` loader), so a malformed doc is refused on Save by the server, not while typing.

## Deviations

- `packages/app-shell/README.md` gains a short "Documentation pages (`doc`)" section (AGENTS.md's docs-driven commandment: a feature is not done until the package README reflects it); the claim's file surface did not list it.
- `metadata-admin/conditionScope.ts` gains the row `doc: 'none'`: registering `doc`'s create hints made it a served type, and `ConditionWidget.conditionScope.test.tsx` requires every served type to carry a ruled row. `none` is the ruling's own last row (a type with no condition key; `DocSchema` declares none).
- `origin/main` was merged in after PR objectui#11207 landed (the menu half's navigation entry); none of its files is edited here.
